priorEvidence.note: Reviewer had seen and produced P08 evidence; P09 is a definition-and-repeatability audit, not a blinded re-pick.

A_ACTIVE_DISPLAY_INNER_CONTENT.definition: the true rectangular active pixel/content boundary of the LCD plane, excluding bezel/aperture/glass fringe
A_ACTIVE_DISPLAY_INNER_CONTENT.cornerMeaning: physical/raster rectangle corners, not virtual tangent intersections
A_ACTIVE_DISPLAY_INNER_CONTENT.reason: the true raster rectangle extends behind or is clipped by the rounded visible aperture; the photographs provide no consistent inactive-margin witness separating raster edge from glass/aperture at all four corners. Bright/blue fringe, moire and displayed content create competing transitions. Four true active-content corners are therefore not directly observable.

B_ROUNDED_INNER_APERTURE_VIRTUAL_QUAD.definition: the visible rounded inner aperture boundary; because physical corners are rounded, each reported virtual corner is the intersection of robust straight-line fits to the central non-rounded portions of adjacent aperture edges
B_ROUNDED_INNER_APERTURE_VIRTUAL_QUAD.cornerMeaning: analytical virtual tangent intersection, not a physical curved-corner pixel and not the hidden LCD panel corner
B_ROUNDED_INNER_APERTURE_VIRTUAL_QUAD.allowedUse: restricted image-space normalization/homography of the visible LCD aperture only
forbiddenUse: OEM framebuffer or native pixel conformity

protocol.sourceIdentity: rehash each original JPEG before annotation
protocol.visualInspection: directly re-inspect all eight originals with local image viewer
protocol.edgeSelection: for class B, use only central straight edge runs and exclude rounded-corner zones; do not trace every pixel
protocol.repeatabilityProbe: repeat local edge-normal picks with Scharr and Sobel gradients and even/odd scan sampling; robustly fit each of four lines and intersect them
acceptNewNumericClassBPointsOnlyIf: all four central straight aperture runs are visible and not materially occluded
maximum pairwise corner spread across the four repeat fits is <= 3 px
maximum local straight-line fit residual is <= 8 px
new virtual corners remain within the prior P08 primary declared 20 px edge ambiguity at every corner
direct visual review does not indicate the fitted line is an internal header/content/divider transition
protocol.uncertaintyPolicy: reported uncertainty must cover both repeat-fit spread and prior P08 class-selection disagreement; it is not a statistical confidence interval

classB.ambiguity: bottom/right aperture-versus-content selection exceeds prior 20 px ambiguity; menu/depth content creates a competing lower transition
top-right boundary class remains just outside the prior 20 px ambiguity; strong sonar/header transitions compete with aperture edge
lower blue/purple fringe makes active-content-versus-aperture bottom selection differ by >20 px
largest class-selection discrepancy in set, especially bottom-right; rounded aperture/bright bottom/fringe do not support a precise class-B annotation
bottom-left and right sonar-strip transitions create aperture-versus-content disagreement >20 px
bottom blue/fringe boundary differs materially from the P08 aperture hypothesis despite very stable local edge fitting, demonstrating semantic rather than numerical ambiguity

acceptanceRecommendation.homography: only dual.jpg and zoom.jpg have P09-accepted class-B virtual quads for restricted in-memory image-space normalization; all stronger or other-image homography claims remain HOLD
acceptanceRecommendation.p08Effect: P08 coordinates remain preserved as hypotheses/evidence. P09 narrows acceptance by separating boundary classes; it does not rewrite or invalidate prior immutable reports.
